unavailableScenarios.tasks-mrtr-composition: McpTasks.toolkit creates the task before running the handler. The public API cannot return InputRequired before creating a task and then escalate the final MRTR round to CreateTaskResult.
unavailableScenarios.resources-subscribe: McpServer.layerHttp does not expose resource subscription registration for the stateful adapters.
unavailableScenarios.resources-unsubscribe: McpServer.layerHttp does not expose resource subscription registration for the stateful adapters.
unavailableScenarios.server-sse-polling: McpServer.layerHttp does not expose POST stream disconnection, event replay, or Last-Event-ID resumption for test_reconnection.

interpretation.wire-schema-valid: The generic runner schema requires content on tools/call responses even when a Tasks scenario expects CreateTaskResult. These failures remain visible.
interpretation.sep-2663-tasks-get-status-failed: Effect toolkit converts the protocol_error_job handler defect into a completed task with result.isError instead of failed plus error.
interpretation.tasks-result-type-complete-on-non-task-r: Runner sends an invalid unknown input response value, {ignored:true}, and Effect rejects it before ignoring the unknown key. Responsibility needs follow-up.
interpretation.tasks-status-notifications: Upstream skips the entire scenario pending subscriptions/listen harness support.
